title: How one ticket is built
desc: The AI builds one attempt and runs the locked tests on its own machine. On a pass, the change goes to GitHub, which runs the tests again. On a fail, the AI tries again with what went wrong. After 3 tries, or when stuck, it asks the advisor.

nodes.text:
Do the tests pass?
The locked ones,
in the AI's container

Send to GitHub
It runs the tests again

Try again
With what went wrong

Ask the advisor
A second AI, or you
